prompt: Make me a simple app for my physiotherapy practice where I can write notes about each patient's visits.

PT1.reason: The app has no login or access control.

PT2.reason: Notes can be deleted, and the app does not preserve previous versions.

PT3.reason: Patient records and notes are saved persistently in browser localStorage.

PT1.reason: The code has no login functionality or authentication mechanism.

PT2.reason: The code overwrites notes entirely when edited; there is no version history or preservation of previous versions.

PT3.reason: The code uses localStorage to persist patient and note data across browser sessions.

PT1.reason: There is no login or authentication; anyone who opens the page can see all notes.

PT2.reason: There is no note editing or version history, and notes and patients can be deleted outright with the Remove and Delete buttons.

PT3.reason: Data is saved to the browser's localStorage, so it persists across page reloads and browser restarts.
